title: Longest Common Subsequence
summary: Return the length of the longest ordered subsequence shared by two strings.
statement: Return the length of the longest ordered subsequence shared by two strings. Implement `longest_common_subsequence` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Matching final characters extend a smaller solution; mismatches discard one side.
Use prefix DP and retain only the prior row.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the longest_common_subsequence invariant is complete.
Editorial: Use prefix DP and retain only the prior row. The intended bounds are O(nm) time and O(m) space.
